pregame.pressurePoint: Vikings passing-down offense vs Saints passing-down defense. The Saints are No. 3 of 32 on passing downs (30%). The Vikings rank No. 32 in passing-downs success (25%). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. The Saints get off the field on long downs. Early-down efficiency is everything for the Vikings. Watch the Vikings on third-and-7 or longer. Punts there mean the defense is winning.

edges.why: The Saints are No. 3 of 32 on passing downs (30%). The Vikings rank No. 32 in passing-downs success (25%). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. The Saints get off the field on long downs. Early-down efficiency is everything for the Vikings.

The Vikings are No. 1 of 32 against the run (29%) and No. 2 by EPA a carry (-0.24). The Saints rank No. 17 in rush success rate (39%) and No. 17 in EPA a carry (-0.06). A clear edge, the kind that shapes a game plan. The Saints will find the run hard going. Expect more second-and-long than usual.

The Saints are No. 18 of 32 in pass explosiveness (1.32) and No. 15 in pass success rate (47%). The Vikings rank No. 29 at limiting explosive passes (1.43) and No. 1 in pass success allowed (35%). A real edge, not a lock. The Saints have the deep ball available. Watch whether the Vikings roll a safety over after the first one.

The Vikings are No. 29 in rush success rate (33%) and No. 20 in EPA a carry (-0.11), and the Saints are No. 32 against the run (54%) and No. 32 by EPA a carry (0.13). Strength on strength. Neither side has shown it can impose the run on a unit this good. The first stuffed series tells you who blinks.
